subtasks.content: Run full-text audit of repository (excluding node_modules/ and dist/) for Python keywords: python, pygls, pythonPath, serverImplementation, requirements.txt, .py, pip, pytest, Black, flake8, mypy. Classify each hit as historical record (preserve) or active guidance/stale artifact (remove/rewrite).

Rewrite .github/copilot-instructions.md to remove all Python 3.9+ requirements, Black/flake8/mypy tooling, pytest patterns, pygls LSP patterns, and Python folder structure. Retain only TypeScript-stack guidance.
Update .github/placeholder to remove Python 3.9+, pytest, Black, flake8, mypy, and pip references.

Update Documentation/PRD.md to replace pygls 2.0 technology references with current TypeScript LSP stack (vscode-languageserver ^9.0.1) and remove the pygls glossary entry and stale pytest coverage metrics.
Review Documentation/IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md line 4 migration reference and update if it serves as active guidance rather than historical record.
Rewrite vscode-extension/src/server/README.md to describe the TypeScript server on its own terms, removing references to the Python implementation and serverImplementation toggle.
Verify .formic/board.json reflects completed status for tasks t-2, t-3, t-4, and t-7. Update if any are incorrectly marked.
Run task lint and task format:check to confirm zero warnings after all changes.
Re-run keyword audit to verify no active Python guidance remains in non-historical files.
